name: Penta-Ocean Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Penta-Ocean Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction of civil engineering and building projects in Japan, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company also constructs tunnels and subways. In addition, it is involved in the sale or rent of real estate and other activities; and shipbuilding, leasing, insurance, and environment businesses. The company was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
